status: source screening complete; no new Dongria-specific finding adopted

sources.title: An evidenced-based, farmer-focused revival of traditional cereals
sources.finding: Perspective article uses 2,082 baseline household surveys from 117 villages in March and August 2023, focused on Mandla and surroundings in central India. Subsequent annual rounds are not reported.
sources.decision: Regional comparative methods only; do not transfer its percentages or household findings to Dongria villages.
sources.reporting_use: A future Dongria-specific enquiry could separately record seed varieties, processing access, amounts sold and amounts retained. This is an editorial proposal, not evidence of local outcomes.
sources.quality_note: Figure 2 caption gives n=2,820 while methods give 2,082; unresolved. No quantitative findings imported.

sources.title: Medicinal uses of few edible tuber crops by “Dongria Kandha” tribes of Kandhamal district of Odisha, India
sources.access: Indexed official repository metadata and abstract; direct landing-page fetch timed out and PDF open failed. Full methods and tables not verified.
sources.finding: The title uses Dongria Kandha, but the abstract locates 25 surveyed villages in two Kandhamal blocks.
sources.decision: Hold as evidence about Niyamgiri Dongria communities pending full methods and clarification of community identification. Do not silently change the authors’ identification or declare it an error.
limits: No verified voucher or determination record obtained.
No species inventory, preparation instruction or treatment claim adopted.
Reported traditional medicinal use would not establish clinical efficacy.

retrieval_note: An alternate Tribal repository flora-report URL was retried before the older scope record was read. It failed certificate hostname verification; no file was recovered and verification was not bypassed. This repeated route adds no evidence and should not be retried without a new basis.
next_evidence_needed: Dated inventory tied to an identified Niyamgiri village and season.
Local plant names connected to verified specimens and determination records.
Full Kandhamal paper methods and a defensible account of participant community identification before any reuse.
article_changes: None: canonical prose, illustrations and review exports remain unchanged.
